china-1914:p0225_1.rationale: Hk. Tls. values of gold, silver and copper in the bullion and specie trade for 1911 and 1912 by entry, with totals. The heading is cut off and the row labels are missing, so it is not clear whether the figures are imports or exports.
review_questions: Row labels (ports or countries) are absent and the heading is cut off; are these import or export figures? Imports and exports are both assigned from the general trade context only.

china-1914:p0225_2.rationale: Continuation group of gold, silver and copper bullion and specie values in Hk. Tls. for 1911 and 1912. Row labels are missing and the direction of trade is unstated.
review_questions: Direction of trade is not stated and row labels are absent; confirm whether these are imports or exports.

china-1914:p0226_1.rationale: Import and export of gold, silver and copper coin and bullion in pounds sterling, 1909-1912, with net import.

china-1914:p0227_1.rationale: Estimated import and export of gold and silver bullion and specie to and from China's commercial area, with Hongkong deducted, 1910-1912, and a net import line.

china-1914:p0231_1.rationale: List of Chinese railways opened or under construction, with opening dates and mileage by line and branch.

china-1914:p0236_1.rationale: Projected railway schemes described mainly in text, covering route, state of the scheme and approximate mileage. Mileage is only incidental to the descriptive entries.

china-1914:p0239_1.rationale: Locomotive stock of the Peking-Mukden railway by number, type, wheel arrangement and maker. It is railway rolling stock.

china-1914:p0241_1.rationale: Numbers of foreign and Chinese employees and their salaries on the Peking-Hankow Railway for 1910.

china-1914:p0241_2.rationale: Cost value of the Peking-Hankow Railway's property, track, rolling stock and assets in taels. It is railway accounting.
review_questions: No railway capital or asset-valuation tag exists in the vocabulary; consider proposing one.

china-1914:p0242_1.rationale: Receipts side of the railway's 1910 profit and loss account, itemised by source.
